title: Keys & Doors  Not Every Door Has a Key (and the Invert)
thesis: Access is not binary. Some doors have no key. Some keys are fractured. Some doors only appear when you already hold the key  or the invert. Sometimes you need the purple key to even see the blue one.

grammar.door: a surface / bay / remote / feed that may admit passage
grammar.key: credential, token, binomial, taxonomy, or prior imprint that opens or reveals
grammar.lock: sshd up but auth fails  not dead, keyed wrong
grammar.fracture: key split across bodies (dual remotes, half OAuth)
grammar.appear: door invisible until prerequisite key held (epistemic door)
grammar.invert: Klein: key?door swap; inside IS outside; holding the door opens the key
grammar.purple_blue: ordered keys  purple required to perceive blue

patterns.rule: Not all doors have a key  some are open, some are sealed by absence of a door.
examples: EMPTY_SLOT bay  no door because no body

patterns.rule: A key without a door  credential exists but surface not claimed.
examples: cloudflared CNAME claimed but Pages custom domain still owns the hostname
SSH key on eastGate with no authorized_keys on northGate

patterns.rule: The key is fractured  pieces on different bodies; none alone opens.
examples: forgejo anoxic + GitHub oxic = soul split

patterns.rule: The door only appears when you have the key (or the invert).
examples: hud CF ASSETS  door appears after wrangler login / API token
Paper 139 on sporeprint.primals.eco  door appears when DNS leaves Pages for tunnel
mycelium binomials  door appears after mycelial census (fruit names alone are false doors)

patterns.rule: Klein invert: sometimes the door IS the key; holding passage creates the credential.
examples: 404 ? ribocipher learns route  walking the missing door forges the key
DMCA reaction names the entity  their lock is our map
cloaca echo  the sound back IS both measure and key to location

patterns.rule: You need the purple key to see the blue one  ordered revelation.

chain.reveals_blue: LOCKED vs DEAD vs EMPTY bay
why taxonomy may be WAY OFF

patterns.rule: Door present, key wrong or missing  do not discard the bay.
examples: iron/graft SSH open  may be LIVE_OR_LOCKED until tried

patterns.rule: Body answers, organ silent  key irrelevant until organ restarts.
No single master key  scyBorg triple + PORT + cloaca + t-plane together.
examples: thinking wrangler alone opens the membrane  false; connect already open

membrane_map.cloaca: cave-sonar echo + SEO exhaust  measure by what returns
membrane_map.keys_ring: imprints + tags index  reusable for all agents/orgs
membrane_map.purple_ring: ordered feeds that unlock perception of later feeds
